reason: The slice has just opened and nothing is ported yet. Every candidate below that the slice owns is missing or undecided: the glyph-offset table, the pure object-glyph macros, the eight object arms of reset_glyphmap(), the ttychar resolution in map_glyphinfo(), the print-time attribute chain in wintty.c, and the removal of the objectGlyphId stand-in that currently spells obj_to_glyph()'s range and index as text.

boundary.startingEvent: The player picks a boolean row from doset_simple()'s menu whose optfn arm sets go.opt_need_glyph_reset. seed0006-wizard-water-demon reaches it at step 64, byte 'f' on page 2, which is hilite_pile.
boundary.endingEvent: The screen the port draws after reset_needed_visuals() returns, that is after display.c reset_glyphmap(gm_optionchange) has rebuilt the object ranges and the docrt() at options.c:9002 has repainted the map through them.
boundary.validInputs: The seven boolean rows sharing options.c:5379-5385 -- wizmgender, showrace, use_inverse, hilite_pile, perm_invent, ascii_map, tiled_map -- picked from doset_simple() or doset(). Configuration families that reach the object arms: hilite_pile on or off, use_inverse on or off, and a level holding at least one object, corpse, statue or pile.
boundary.observables: levl[x][y].glyph as an unresolved glyph number in map memory rather than a resolved presentation; the MG_OBJPILE glyphflag; the character, colour and attribute the repaint prints for every remembered out-of-sight object square; the screens and cursor positions of the menu and the repaint; and the absence of any new random-number call, since none of the ported arms consumes randomness outside the Hallucination branch.
boundary.exclusions: The terrain layer -- display.c back_to_glyph() and reset_glyphmap()'s cmap, altar and wall-set arms -- which stays behind the 'color' refusal this slice introduces and belongs to a later slice. Also excluded: reset_customcolors() and reset_customsymbols(), whose sibling refusals stay; reglyph_darkroom() over a dark_room change, which keeps its own refusal; and the monster, pet, detected-monster, invisible, ridden, swallow, explosion, zap and warning arms of reset_glyphmap(), except where MG_DETECT shares the print-time attribute path with MG_OBJPILE.

Reading the whole chain found eight, not the six first reported: the four piletop arms (GLYPH_STATUE_FEM_PILETOP_OFF, GLYPH_STATUE_MALE_PILETOP_OFF, GLYPH_BODY_PILETOP_OFF, GLYPH_OBJ_PILETOP_OFF) sit high in the chain, and GLYPH_STATUE_FEM_OFF and GLYPH_STATUE_MALE_OFF just below them, but GLYPH_OBJ_OFF at 2968 and GLYPH_BODY_OFF at 3004 sit below every cmap arm. sourceReview: Traced at e310ec0 by the orchestrator, before any implementation. Read in full: include/display.h enum glyph_offsets (497-547) and the object-glyph macros at 638, 798, 806, 844, 858, 877 and 932-968; the arm chain of src/display.c reset_glyphmap() far enough to place all eight object arms and the closing colour clamp at 3072-3078; win/tty/wintty.c:3920-3936; and, on the JavaScript side, the refusal and its neighbouring arms in js/options.js, the objectGlyphId stand-in and the five ATR_INVERSE bakes in js/display.js, the same_remembered_glyph() consumer in js/lock.js, the marked matrix entry in scripts/run-options-menu.mjs, and the deferral text in QUALITY.json. Three claims inherited from the slice-selector's report were checked and corrected: obj_to_glyph() and statue_to_glyph() are not pure, reset_glyphmap() has eight object arms rather than six, and the GLYPH_RESET_PICKS matrix entry was marked outside the limit rather than deleted. Not yet traced: display.c show_glyph() (1877-2072), the arm chain below GLYPH_MON_MALE_OFF, whether any development session reaches a rogue level, and whether any reaches the Hallucination arms with an object drawn. Those four are the entries carrying status undecided or the limits recorded in remainingLimits.
